**Install:** open the disk image and drag ATLAS to Applications, or run `brew install --cask zahintapadar/tap/atlas`.

**First launch:** ATLAS isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS stops it the first time. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to "ATLAS was blocked". You only do this once.

Requires macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel. Scheduled check-ins also need Claude Code signed in with a Claude subscription; tracking, Timeline and Reports work without it.
